claims.text: The Follow-Up Builder is a free tool that generates a follow-up message sequence from a few business inputs
No signup or card required to use the free tools
Most follow-up effort stops after a single message

disclosure: The five-minute response figure reflects commonly cited speed-to-lead research (e.g., Lead Response Management studies) showing roughly 2x higher contact/close rates for fast follow-up. Presented as an industry pattern, not a Black Arrow-specific result.

claims.text: Replying within five minutes instead of letting a lead sit roughly doubles the odds of closing it
Matching reply channel to how a lead first reached out (call-back vs text, same-thread reply, personal call for referrals) builds trust faster and reduces perceived brush-offs
